## 2. Single offer: Fixed-fee Cloud & AI Cost Governance Diagnostic

- **Scope:** https://aicloudstrategist.com/services/
- **Pricing:** https://aicloudstrategist.com/pricing/
- **Who it is for:** Finance, engineering, operations, and platform leaders with unexplained or unowned AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes, or GPU/LLM spend
- **Deliverables:**
  1. Owned spend map (assigned, shared, unallocated)
  2. Decision register — Act / Investigate / Hold with confidence, risk, and owner
  3. 30-day prioritized action plan (client implements; no production changes by AICloudStrategist)
- **Commercial model:**
  - Step 1 — Free fit review (no billing files required)
  - Step 2 — Fixed fee after scope in writing
  - Typical bands: **USD 2,500–3,000** single-estate; **USD 5,500–12,000** complex multi-cloud/GPU (India visitors see INR bands on site)
  - Optional **20% founding offer** for new customers — confirmed only in written proposal (not savings-share)
- **Samples:** https://aicloudstrategist.com/resources/sample-diagnostic-deliverable/ · https://aicloudstrategist.com/downloads/sample-cloud-ai-cost-governance-diagnostic.pdf
- **Process:** https://aicloudstrategist.com/how-we-work/
- **Data handling:** https://aicloudstrategist.com/data-handling/
- **Scope & limits:** https://aicloudstrategist.com/scope-and-limits/
